truthQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_customers on customer_id = t_customers.customer_id } -> { where: t_customers.signup_date.year = @2025; aggregate: cohort_revenue is sale_price.sum() }
verifyQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_customers on customer_id = t_customers.customer_id } -> { group_by: signup_year is t_customers.signup_date.year; aggregate: revenue is sale_price.sum() } -> { where: signup_year ? @2025; select: revenue }
